versions.changelog:
- Initial release of proof-of-quality (PoQ) skill.
- Implements Bitcoin-like PoW for skill benchmarking and verifiable quality proof.
- Users benchmark skills, grind nonce until benchmark score (speed/accuracy/security) > threshold and hash meets difficulty.
- Outputs a PoQ JSON ({score, hash, nonce}) for sharing and independent verification.
- Designed to prevent low-quality submissions and enable antifragile merit-based evaluation.
